preToolUse.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}}}"; if command -v bun >/dev/null && [ -f "$r/src/cli.ts" ]; then exec bun "$r/src/cli.ts" hook pre --for copilot; fi
preToolUse.powershell: $r = @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, '.') | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ((Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and (Test-Path "$r/src/cli.ts")) { $input | bun "$r/src/cli.ts" hook pre --for copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

postToolUse.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}}}"; if command -v bun >/dev/null && [ -f "$r/src/cli.ts" ]; then exec bun "$r/src/cli.ts" hook post --for copilot; fi
postToolUse.powershell: $r = @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, '.') | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ((Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and (Test-Path "$r/src/cli.ts")) { $input | bun "$r/src/cli.ts" hook post --for copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
